SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $4 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

INSERT INTO anchors
	            (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	             src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, updated_at,
	             src_type, dst_type)
	        SELECT id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, $1, now(),
	               src_type, dst_type
	        FROM unnest(
	            CAST($2 AS uuid[]), CAST($3 AS text[]),
	            CAST($4 AS text[]), CAST($5 AS text[]),
	            CAST($6 AS text[]), CAST($7 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($8 AS uuid[]), CAST($9 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($10 AS boolean[]), CAST($11 AS jsonb[]),
	            CAST($12 AS text[]), CAST($13 AS text[])
	        ) AS t(id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, src_type, dst_type)
	        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
	            kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
	            arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
	            arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
	            fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
	            root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
	            src = EXCLUDED.src,
	            dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
	            undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
	            props = EXCLUDED.props,
	            format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
	            updated_at = now(),
	            -- an edge re-saved while its endpoints are unpopulated stubs
	            -- carries NULL types; keep whatever was recorded earlier
	            src_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.src_type, anchors.src_type),
	            dst_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dst_type, anchors.dst_type)

INSERT INTO graph_types (type_name, ancestor)
	            SELECT * FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS text[]), CAST($2 AS text[]))
	            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
